---
title: Bare PNG figures from Julia
engine: julia
---

A prose block before the cells, so the unit ordinal and the cell counter differ.

```{julia}
using Plots
display(MIME("image/png"), plot(1:5, (1:5) .^ 2))
```

Between the cells.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: A labeled bare PNG.
display(MIME("image/png"), plot(1:5, sqrt.(1:5)))
```

See @fig-b.
